1639. Polymorphism, Method Overloading

50

Medium

Problem Statement:
Write a program to implement method overloading in which a class provides multiple calculate methods that handle addition of two integers, two floating-point numbers, and concatenation of two strings.

Description:
The program should demonstrate polymorphism by defining three overloaded methods named calculate. The main method should take user input, determine the type of data entered, and call the appropriate method dynamically.

Input Format:
First line: Data type (int, float, or string)
Next two lines: Values of that type

Output Format:

Result after applying the overloaded calculate method
